name: 募集している担当シフト一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0014 募集している担当シフト一覧. Image1 ORIGINAL Grab Driver source takes priority for small marker geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine row details. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized content/layout guide. Image3 approved bus is white surface/elevation style only. Render only the existing THREE localized shift rows, not the full source planner/calendar/nav or additional English source rows.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, one compact logical390x274 white rounded list surface with fine neutral boundary and soft subtle shadow. No separate nested card per row. Three rows separated by thin inset neutral dividers. EACH row: quiet small 「担当シフト」; next line time on left and remaining count right; third line a SMALL FOREST-GREEN RING MARKER with WHITE CENTER (faithful source circle-with-white-hole geometry, NOT mock's solid dot), then place/team text.
Row1 exact: 「担当シフト」 / 「09:00–10:30」 / 「残り2名」 / 「礼拝室・受付チーム」.
Row2 exact: 「担当シフト」 / 「10:30–12:00」 / 「残り1名」 / 「礼拝室・案内チーム」.
Row3 exact: 「担当シフト」 / 「12:00–13:00」 / 「残り3名」 / 「会場・片付けチーム」.
Retain saved Japanese time/count/place adaptations and three-row count; do not add source costs, English place names, further shifts, chevrons, buttons or metrics. Meiryo body14/24regular, metadata12/16regular, tracking0; modest weight hierarchy, no bold giant headings. Align source-style row baselines, right counts and marker/text, compact but readable.
Accent decision: original identical green ring marker is a coherent shared shift/location category symbol, retain consistent forest-green #1F6444 for all THREE markers with white center, logical10–12px diameter. Other text #1D1D1D, secondary counts/labels #6E6E6E, neutral dividers. No primary action exists here so no invented gradient button or colored row surfaces. White canvas/rows, restrained corners/shadow, no mint wash, random per-role colors, gloss or decoration. Original optical details outrank rough mock shapes. Static raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画優先の白芯リングと三行の日時/残人数/担当名、整列/白面/切れなしを保持。リングの緑が正式森林緑より明るく生成され、色だけ要修正。新しい項目/値/操作は追加なし。画像修正待ち、実装等なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
